title: Symplectic Clique-Cover Duality, Signed Frustration Atoms, and Zero-Enumeration Exact-Q Robustness-of-Magic Certificates for Multi-Qubit Quantum States
abstract: Certifying non-stabilizerness (quantum magic) and bounding the Robustness of Magic R(rho) for multi-qubit mixed states is central to fault-tolerant quantum computation, yet exact linear-programming membership in the stabilizer polytope STAB_n encounters a 2^{Theta(n^2)} vertex wall beyond n ~ 5 qubits, while pure-state monotones such as Stabilizer Renyi Entropy fail for mixed states. Building on recent worst-case random access code (RAC) frameworks (Zamora, arXiv:2611.26705), we introduce a zero-enumeration, zero-floating-point-trust dual certification framework based on two elementary symplectic atoms over F_2^{2n}: anticommuting Pauli cliques (C in [-1, +1] on STAB_n) and signed frustrated commuting triples (F in [-3, +1] via F_2-subgroup closure, strictly below their unsigned independence number 3). First, we prove the Symplectic Atom-Cover and Chvatal-Gomory Rounding Theorem (Theorem 2.2): any conical decomposition W = sum_j y_j C_j + sum_l z_l F_l (y_j, z_l in Q_{>=0}) yields exact stabilizer bounds [-beta_-, +beta_+] (sharpened by integer floors whenever W has integer weights), certifying exact mixed-state Robustness of Magic R(rho) >= 1 + 2(Tr(W rho) - beta_+)/(beta_+ + beta_-) and depolarizing noise tolerance p_cert = 1 - beta_+/Tr(W rho) without enumerating STAB_n. Second, we establish exact worst-case RAC bounds (Theorem 2.3), including B_wc(sigma) <= 1/(2^n + 1) on all non-identity Paulis P_n \ {I}. Third, we prove an exponential separation over the standard Pauli l1-norm bound (Theorem 2.4): on the rank-2^{n-1} mixed Majorana-clique state rho_{K_{2n+1}} (purity 2^{1-n} -> 0), Pauli l1-norm decays as (1+sqrt(2n+1))/2^n -> 0 (blind for all n >= 2), whereas our (2n+1)-Pauli clique certificate proves R(rho_{K_{2n+1}}) >= sqrt(2n+1) (p_cert = 1 - 1/sqrt(2n+1)), reaching R >= 8.062 and p_cert = 87.6% at n = 32 qubits (bypassing |STAB_32| ~ 10^{168.95}) in under 2 ms. Fourth, we resolve the stabilizer-marginal problem for arbitrary n-qubit W-states (Theorem 2.5): every 2-qubit marginal of |W_n> lies inside STAB_2, yet the three weight-<=2 Paulis {Z_0, X_0 X_1, Y_0 Y_2} certify R(|W_n>) >= R(rho^(3)_{W_n}) >= 1 + 2/n for all n >= 3. Fifth, we prove a strict 3-tier hierarchy (Theorem 2.6) separating Signed Frustration Atoms > Chvatal-Gomory Clique Covers (C_5 pentagram) > Single Cliques (|CCZ>, K_{2n+1}) > Pauli l1-Norm. All 16 core theorems are mechanized in zero-dependency Lean 4 (v4.35.0, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice), and our exact-Q verifier validates 9/9 published certificates (n = 1..32) while rejecting 28/28 live adversarial forgery, canonical-parser, and type-injection attacks.
